messages:
maria: Heads-up — after merging the model-onboard PR (v2.3.0) we're seeing a clear p99 latency jump in staging (~2.2x). Not in prod yet but holding rollouts. :warning:
sam: I can reproduce locally against staging-image. p50 stable, p95 small uptick, p99 +120ms per token on average. Traces point to a different kernel being selected for attention when seq_len > 1024.
jon: Uploading flamegraph: https://artifacts.internal/ff/1854321000/flame.svg — kernel selection path shows fallback to "attn_kernel_fallback_v2" for a subset of requests (looks like FP32 path).
carla: CI perf job also flaked earlier: ci-bot: perf/checks-staging #412 failed: p99_token_latency_regression (threshold 8%). Link: https://ci/reports/412
ci-bot: @eng-runtime CI detected regression in perf-staging after commit 7a3c9b1 (model-onboard). See artifacts.
jon: Quick diff of the onboard PR hint: tokenizer config set add_bos=true and reserved_ids mapping changed. That shifts byte offsets for some sequences and increases average tokenized length by ~3% for our test prompts. Example: `len(tokenize("Hello\nWorld"))` went from 18 -> 20 on the new checkpoint.
sam: Increased seq len explains kernel mis-selection (kernel chooser heur uses seq_len distribution). But why FP32 fallback? We didn't change quant flags.
maria: Runtime logs show: `kernel_selector: chosen=attn_kernel_fallback_v2 reason=quant_unavailable for model=redwood/v2.3.0` — looks like the compiled kernels for the quantized variant didn't match the new model config (maybe name/version mismatch).
jon: Reproduced: when model.config.tokenizer_version != kernel_profile.tokenizer_version the runtime rejects the optimized kv/quant kernels and picks fallback. That was an edge case — onboarding script didn't update kernel_profile.tokenizer_version.
carla: So two problems: tokenization increases seq lengths (more batching pressure) + fallback to slower kernel (higher per-token). Combined causes p99 spike.
sam: Quick mitigation options: 1) Pin old tokenizer config in staging (revert tokenizer changes in model metadata), 2) Force kernel route to quantized kernel for this version (risky), 3) Rollback model onboard PR.
maria: I propose hold the rollout + rollback PR for the model metadata change (7a3c9b1). Prepare a small revert: `git revert --no-commit 7a3c9b1` and run canary.
jon: Running bisect locally to be sure it's 7a3c9b1 as root cause: `git bisect start HEAD v2.2.9 -- script=./tools/perf_check.sh --target p99` — initial bisect points to 7a3c9b1 indeed.
ci-bot: bisect-result: culprit commit 7a3c9b1 — tokenization/config bump.
sre-oncall: Can someone hold the Dedicated/Dedicated-rollout policy while we investigate? I flagged the release in the console and set automatic rollout to paused.
carla: I'll open a revert PR now and request urgent review. @sam can you validate that reverting metadata restores kernel_profile match?
sam: On it. Quick patch: update model.metadata.tokenizer_version back to "tok-v1" and re-upload kernel_profile metadata blob. If that works, we can re-onboard with coordinated kernel_profile bump.
maria: Also adding a unit test to the onboarding pipeline that verifies kernel_profile.tokenizer_version == model.metadata.tokenizer_version and that compiled kernels exist for quant paths.
infra-bot: deploy-check: hold placed on model-v2.3.0 rollout by carla.
jon: Forensics note: KV cache behavior looked noisy in traces — some requests had repeated KV invalidations due to shifted eos tokens in the new tokenizer, causing extra cache flush/rehash churn. That magnifies latency variance.
sam: Reverting metadata locally restores previous token lengths and kernel selection -> p99 back to baseline. I'll push the revert PR and tag for hotfix.
carla: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/models/pull/662/revert-model-v2.3-tokenizer-metadata — requesting 2 reviewers, marking as rollback-hotfix.
maria: Good. Post-rollback action items: 1) add onboarding guard tests, 2) update docs for kernel_profile versioning, 3) coordinate kernel-profile compilation step with model onboarding so metadata and compiled kernels land together.
sre-oncall: Thanks team. After the rollback and one canary run we can unpause rollout. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
sam: ETA for hotfix rollout: 25-30m after PR merge, will run canary and perf job.
carla: Adding this to incident tracker /incidents with brief timeline.
maria: closing loop — after hotfix and test additions I'll schedule a retro with infra/rls to avoid repeat.
jon: FYI adding a short perf test to CI that simulates token-length distribution changes to catch small tokenizer drifts.
carla: Reaction :eyes: on jon's last message."
